unusual_experiment.name: UTF8_VS_UTF16_ASTRAL_KEY_ORDER_FORK
unusual_experiment.hypothesis: The selected typed canonicalizer remains cross-language stable even for object keys whose UTF-8 byte ordering differs from JavaScript default UTF-16 code-unit ordering.
unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis: A hidden or default JavaScript UTF-16 key sort can produce a stable but different causal digest from the Python UTF-8-byte ordering, silently forking identity.
unusual_experiment.intervention: Canonicalize one object containing U+E000 and U+10000 keys using exact Python selected bytes, an independent Node UTF-8 Buffer comparator, and a deliberately wrong Node default Array.sort control.
